is_codes.title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
is_codes.description: Thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel bars for concrete reinforcement. Minimum yield strength specified. Fe415, Fe500, Fe500D, Fe550, and Fe600 grades available.

is_codes.title: Hot rolled low, medium and high tensile structural steel
is_codes.description: Structural steel for general building and construction purposes. E250, E350, and E410 grades with varying tensile strengths.
